returningInjured.comment: Adames (elbow) intends to take batting practice and participate in fielding work Monday, Justice delos Santos of The San Jose Mercury News reports.
Valdez (hamstring) isn't in the lineup for Saturday's game against the Cubs.
Sheets (foot) took part in live batting practice Monday, MLB.com reports.
The Marlins placed Caissie on the 10-day injured list Sunday due to a lumbar stress reaction.
Guardians manager Stephen Vogt said Friday that Hoskins (back) has begun a swing progression program, MLB.com reports.

Pederson (hand) took some swings in the batting cage Friday and is scheduled to face teammate Jack Leiter (ankle/biceps) in live batting practice this weekend, Shawn McFarland of The Dallas Morning News reports.
Grisham (hamstring) took part in live batting practice Wednesday, MLB.com reports.
Judge (calf) said Wednesday that he intends to be ready to play in Game 1 of the American League Wild Card Series, Bryan Hoch of MLB.com reports.
The Mariners transferred Raley (forearm) from the 10-day injured list to the 60-day IL on Wednesday.
The Astros placed Varsho on the 10-day injured list Thursday, retroactive to Wednesday, due to left wrist inflammation.
Red Sox manager Chad Tracy indicated Tuesday that Mead (wrist) is a long shot to be available for the postseason, Chris Cotillo of MassLive.com reports.
Devers (abdomen) is expected to undergo season-ending surgery Tuesday, Alex Pavlovic of NBC Sports Bay Area reports.
Buxton will undergo season-ending arthroscopic surgery on his right hip Sept. 18, Aaron Gleeman of AaronGleeman.com reports.
Kurtz (thumb) began a hitting progression Wednesday, Martin Gallegos of MLB.com reports.
The Giants transferred Schmitt (knee) to the 60-day injured list Saturday.
The Athletics transferred Soderstrom (hip) to the 60-day injured list Thursday.
The Orioles placed Basallo (concussion) on the 7-day injured list Wednesday.
Eldridge was placed on the 7-day concussion injured list Monday, retroactive to Friday.
Steer will undergo right wrist surgery next Wednesday, Gordon Wittenmyer of the Cincinnati Enquirer reports.
Castro (heel/knee) said Wednesday that he will miss the remainder of the 2026 season, MLB.com reports.
The Tigers announced Friday that Carpenter (foot) has ramped up his running and hitting progression with the hope of returning from the injured list before the end of the season, MLB.com reports.
The Twins placed Larnach on the 10-day injured list Friday with left wrist soreness, Aaron Gleeman of AaronGleeman.com reports.
